findings.title: Onboarding approval is not tenant provisioning
evidence: backend/platform-control/src/main/java/com/quincaisoft/platformcontrol/application/DefaultPlatformService.java: approve sets APPROVED_FOR_PROVISIONING; no tenant creation in this service
findings.exit: Verified create company/branch/owner/entitlements transaction, outbox and retry; fail/rollback/retry without duplicate tenant; lifecycle suspend/restore.

findings.title: Subscription billing lifecycle is incomplete
findings.exit: Trial/active/grace/past-due/suspended/cancelled transitions, plan/seat/branch limits, billing records and independently verified payments; no data destruction on expiry.

findings.title: Manufacturer/family/variant and supplier offers block dataset ingestion
evidence: docs/dataset-import-evidence.md: all 245514 candidate records blocked; zero imported
findings.exit: Typed identity with 10 manufacturers per type, independent supplier offerings, scoped uniqueness and exact per-SKU stock; chronological importer/replay, all required source IDs accounted for.

findings.title: HR/payroll history is not an implemented business workflow
findings.exit: Define extension contract, employees/attendance/contracts/payroll approval and journals, payslips and role restrictions. Synthetic rates cannot become statutory defaults.

findings.title: Current-role authorization acceptance remains unresolved
evidence: backend/api-server/src/main/java/com/quincaisoft/security/TenantScopeFilter.java: token scope/epoch context; no effective capability intersection here
findings.exit: Inspect complete security path and test old roles/new epoch, revoked membership, cross-tenant/company/branch, report/download/job capabilities and own-customer access; source inspection alone is not an exploit proof.

findings.title: Full migration acceptance is unresolved
findings.exit: Fresh current-commit full reactor/PostgreSQL and module acceptance; resolve required parity cases individually. Historical tests cannot certify new code.

findings.title: Original dashboard meaning and complete screen parity are not preserved
evidence: apps/web-admin/app/page.tsx: record counts and mixed activity list replace original operational metrics
docs/WORK_ALLOCATION.md: final visual and narrow-width verification pending
findings.exit: Original layouts/actions/tabs and authorized live Java aggregates for sales, low stock, collection and profit. Before/after visual and behavior acceptance for every canonical screen.

findings.title: Live mobile-money acceptance and Orange implementation are incomplete
findings.exit: Implement authorized contracts, signature/replay/ambiguity and reconciliation safeguards; execute provider sandbox and approved live acceptance. Never mark simulated payment verified.

findings.title: Storefront checkout/order lifecycle is not exposed by reviewed API
findings.exit: Cart/order state machine, inventory reservations through M09, payment outcome reconciliation, own-order access, delivery/returns and compensations.

findings.title: Reports and document families are partial and require semantic mapping
evidence: docs/migration/canonical-migration-coverage.json: 76 reports, 26 document families, 190 document fields in register
findings.exit: Map all canonical IDs/fields to fixed sources/templates/metrics; test original snapshots, permissions, date basis, pagination totals, EN/FR, A4/58/80mm and reprint audit. 17 definitions are not 17 accepted canonical workflows.

findings.title: Backups and restore have not been demonstrated
evidence: backend/business-modules/operations/src/main/java/com/quincaisoft/operations/api/OperationsService.java: manifest/integrity/rehearsal APIs; not a database backup proof
findings.exit: Encrypted off-host backup, WAL/PITR retention and actual restore rehearsal; RPO/RTO measured; rekey/revoke credentials/grants and reconcile tenant/ledger after recovery.

findings.title: Production deployment target and environment acceptance are absent
evidence: infrastructure/compose.yaml: expressly local development database only
docs/dataset-import-evidence.md: local preview only, deployment/TLS/monitoring NOT_RUN
findings.exit: Established authorized host/account/domain, immutable build, runtime secrets, TLS, migrations, health/readiness, least-privilege network, monitored deploy/rollback and load checks.

findings.title: Ownership and evidence are fragmented and partially stale
evidence: docs/WORK_ALLOCATION.md contains older pending statements and later follow-up
findings.exit: One control index, exact module/file owners, acknowledged handoffs, canonical inventory and current commit-bound test results. Never equate assignment with execution.

findings.title: Specialized materials workflows need complete acceptance
evidence: datasets/business-history/COVERAGE.md: lots, packs, CUT/REPACK, reservations, custody and late costs not fully covered by fixture
findings.exit: Prove length/area/volume/weight conversions, lot/serial/expiry, cut remnants/waste, pack split, damaged custody, partial deliveries and late-cost/final-unit conservation.

findings.title: Company-wide financial and corporate features need explicit scope decisions
evidence: ARCHITECTURE.md §37: operational journal, not statutory accounting claim
findings.exit: Complete required operational AR/AP/cash/bank/periods/taxes/reconciliation. Explicitly classify fixed assets, depreciation, statutory payroll/accounts, budgeting, CRM/projects as required extension or out-of-scope; no hidden claim of a complete general-purpose ERP.

findings.title: Production security/performance/recovery evidence is missing
findings.exit: Risk-appropriate OWASP ASVS test mapping, dependency findings resolved, tenant isolation under concurrent load, agreed latency/capacity targets, alert/failure and recovery evidence.
